lead: A `#[cfg(feature = "…")]` module inside a test file is compiled only by the CI leg that turns the feature on.
body: `perf_guards.rs`'s `wasm_guards` used a helper from its parent without importing it and nothing local noticed: `cargo build --all-targets`, `nv verify` and clippy all compile the file with the module cfg'd out. When a job whose name mentions the feature fails to compile a file that has been green for months, check the module's own `use` list first.
